AUDIT_FINDINGS.PREVIOUS_HEURISTIC_DEFECT: The previous implementation used a scalar isotropic Gaussian variance (inv_var = 0.32, sigma = 1.77 px) rather than computing the true local anisotropic Jacobian ellipse. This introduced excessive blur.

CORRECTED_TRUE_EWA_MAPPING.JACOBIAN_ORIENTATION: Output-to-source: J = d(u,v)/d(x_pano, y_pano) computed via central differences in spherical equirectangular coordinates.
CORRECTED_TRUE_EWA_MAPPING.ELLIPSE_INVERSE: Q = M^-1 evaluates anisotropic distance d_sq = delta_uv^T @ Q @ delta_uv.
CORRECTED_TRUE_EWA_MAPPING.WEIGHT_NORMALIZATION: Gaussian weight w = exp(-0.5 * d_sq) clamped to 3-sigma support (d_sq <= 9), normalized by sum of weights.

GATE_EVALUATION.REASON: While True EWA accurately suppresses aliasing (alias energy decreased), MTF50 and edge location improvements do not simultaneously achieve the >= 15% threshold over bilinear against the true Area Reference.
